fusions.name: Heaved Bedrock
fusions.desc: Catches the bedrock and hauls it up under every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 earth damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Driven Piton
fusions.desc: Throws a stone piton that deals 8 rock damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Deadman Anchor
fusions.desc: Sets your barb into bedrock and braces on it, raising your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Purchase on Stone
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
